newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's SOLIDERE shares continue rally.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's SOLIDERE shares continue rally.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares rose on Monday on the Beirut Secondary Market (BSM) continuing a rally begun last week.
A shares rose 3.57 percent on the privately-operated BSM to $112.375 from Friday's $108.5 and B shares rose 2.13 percent to $113.750 from $111.375.
Turnover on the BSM, which trades only SOLIDERE shares, rose to 12,724 shares from Friday's 8,403 and value was $1,414,412.875 from $912,642.5.

Dealers say momentum is building up on the Beirut equities market because of the victory of billionaire Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri in parliamentary elections and expectations that SOLIDERE will make a GDR issue of up to $150 million, giving non-Arab investors access to the market for the first time.
SOLIDERE declined to comment last week on market rumours of the impending issue.
On the Beirut Stock Exchange, Ciments Libanais was steady at $1.375 on sale of 200 shares and Eternit was also steady at $1.9375 with 1,000 shares sold.
There was no trade in the two other listed companies Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
The BLOM Stock Index rose 2.57 percent to 976.30 and the LISPI index rose 0.81 percent to 84.95. They cover both markets.
